data.title: bn-2otl: locate line-anchored threads in the review target after rebase

data.reason: Reviewed: new anchor::AnchorLocator used by review/diff/status/threads show; outdated threads stay listed and marked, unresolvable anchors report unknown instead of a false unchanged; range drift is now O(diff), proved equal to per-line oracle by proptest, 1..u32::MAX test instant (lead blocker, fixed); status pinned to review target by test; 16 mutations killed. JSON changes additive.
